dict.string: When you tap Voice Mode in the HUD, Rotagivan records a short command and sends audio to OpenRouter/xAI for transcription. Text and action descriptions are sent to Jev to suggest actions. Nothing runs until you confirm.

Rotagivan reads ZSA Navigator touch reports and, when enabled, Apple trackpad touches for gesture actions. Pointer movement pauses while an Apple-controlled App Explorer or Window Manager is open; normal movement resumes when it closes or enters editing.
